#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll solve(ll n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    if (n < 0) return solve(-n);
    
    vector<ll> dp(n + 1, INT_MAX);
    dp[0] = 0;
    
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ll num = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= 18; j++) {
            num = num * 10 + 1;
            if (num > i) break;
            dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - num] + j);
            if (num * 10 + 1 > i && num != i) {
                ll next_num = num * 10 + 1;
                if (next_num <= 2 * n) {
                    dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[next_num - i] + j + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return dp[n];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll input_value;
    cin >> input_value;
    cout << solve(input_value);
    
    return 0;
}
